title: Robinhood Adds Bitcoin to Its Balance Sheet: A Strategic Signal from a $100B Fintech
summary: Bitcoin Magazine Robinhood Adds Bitcoin to Its Balance Sheet: A Strategic Signal from a $100B Fintech Robinhood added $25M of Bitcoin (~294 BTC) to its balance sheet—its first corporate holding and a strategic signal from a $100B fintech. This post Robinhood Adds Bitcoin to Its Balance Sheet: A Strategic Signal from a $100B Fintech first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Nick Ward .
